head: 7a2c8b9
summary: 8.7, the same as confirm3. No PY geometry, material or colour changed, and I checked that myself. All eight studio renders (p1-p8) are pixel-identical to st_base. In q13, every changed pixel is above y 212, and the seat-back boxes are byte-identical: (190,420,340,570) B/R 1.383, L 105.7; (260,300,400,500) B/R 1.360. The rear-row headrests at y 175-230 have zero delta. In q14 the mid back (260,300,400,500) is identical (B/R 1.301, L 119.9). The few changed pixels near the foreground shell top and headrest (y 85-107, L 181-207) are sidewall and bin behind the silhouette edge, not seat. Small correction to the brief's numbers: any-change is 31.8 % (q13) and 24.2 % (q14); at |d|>8 it is 21.2 % and 8.1 %, which matches the brief's figures. Everything I scored at confirm3 is untouched. The pitch reads the same as the 37302 rows, and so do the back height to the headrest flap, the wraparound grey shell, the wide console with the cup nose, the gooseneck, the navy flap and ears, and the legrest. The only new effect is context: the cooler and slightly darker surround makes the light-grey shells and the fabric read marginally more like the photo's cool cabin. It gets no score credit, because that is lighting. The carried-over lows below keep it under 9.
lighting_note: Not scored. The white-balance change moves the PY surround toward the photo hue but away from its value. q13 rear wall: L 205 -> 188, B-R 4.2 -> 10.3 (py_37302 rear wall L 226, B-R 11.0). Right wall: L 205 -> 192, B-R 1.5 -> 12.2 (photo L 220, B-R 18.4). Ceiling: L 216 -> 207, B-R 4.3 -> 10.3. Whole top band (y < 110): L 212.6 -> 202.8, B-R 4.5 -> 10.5. The hue is now right, but the walls and bulkhead are about 35 L under the photo, so the cabin reads a little dim and greyer. Seat fabric against wall contrast is 106/188 = 0.56, against about 0.55-0.65 in the photo, which is fine. The q14 diamond sun patch on the window-seat back (x 485-550, y 300-420) is unchanged at L 162.7 and is still the brightest patch on any PY back. L<25 counts: q13 8934 -> 9077 (+1.6 %, all upper band, mostly darker curtain folds and bin seams) and q14 9719 -> 9725.
